name: KIP Real Estate Investment Trust
overview: KIP REIT 今年以 RM435 million 完成收购 Setapak Central Mall，并通过 200,000,000 个新单位的配售集资；同时终止了 Klang 工业物业剩余租赁权益的买卖协议。零售板块资产组合扩大，工业板块则有一项收购未完成。
overview_en: KIP REIT completed the acquisition of Setapak Central Mall for RM435 million and raised funds via a placement of 200,000,000 new units this year, while terminating the sale and purchase agreement for the remaining lease interest in the Klang industrial property. The retail segment's asset portfolio expanded, while one industrial acquisition was not completed.

segments.name: 零售物业
segments.note: 今年完成收购 Setapak Central Mall，扩大零售商场资产组合。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of Setapak Central Mall this year, expanding the retail mall portfolio.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Setapak Central Mall 收购于 2026 年 9 月 30 日完成，余额购价已结清。
actions.text_en: The acquisition of Setapak Central Mall was completed on 30 September 2026 following settlement of the balance purchase consideration.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Setapak Central Mall 的买卖协议于 2026 年 7 月 23 日转为无条件。
actions.text_en: The sale and purchase agreement for Setapak Central Mall turned unconditional on 23 July 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 签订有条件买卖协议，以 RM435 million 现金收购位于 Setapak, Kuala Lumpur 的 Setapak Central Mall（三层购物中心及地下停车场）。
actions.text_en: Entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement to acquire Setapak Central Mall (a three-storey shopping mall with basement carpark) in Setapak, Kuala Lumpur, for a cash consideration of RM435 million.

segments.name: 工业物业
segments.note: 今年终止了 Klang 工业物业剩余租赁权益的收购。
segments.note_en: Terminated the acquisition of the remaining lease interest in the Klang industrial property this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: SPA 3 条件期限于 2026 年 5 月 28 日届满，双方同意终止该 Klang 工业物业剩余租赁权益的收购，订金将退还。
actions.text_en: The conditional period of SPA 3 expired on 28 May 2026 and the parties mutually agreed to terminate the acquisition of the remaining lease interest in the Klang industrial property, with the deposit to be refunded.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将 Klang 工业物业收购（SPA 3）的条件期限延长至 2026 年 5 月 28 日。
actions.text_en: Both parties agreed to extend the conditional period of the Klang industrial property acquisition (SPA 3) until 28 May 2026.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成配售集资，为收购 Setapak Central Mall 提供资金。
segments.note_en: Completed a placement this year to fund the acquisition of Setapak Central Mall.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 200,000,000 个配售单位于 2026 年 8 月 27 日上市，配售完成。
actions.text_en: 200,000,000 placement units were listed on 27 August 2026, completing the placement.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 配售发售价定为每单位 RM0.815。
actions.text_en: The placement issue price was fixed at RM0.815 per unit.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 7 月 3 日批准最多 220,000,000 个配售单位的上市及报价。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved the listing and quotation of up to 220,000,000 placement units on 3 July 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 于 2026 年 6 月 3 日向 Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad 提交上市申请。
actions.text_en: Submitted the listing application to Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad on 3 June 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 委任 CIMB Investment Bank Berhad 和 Maybank Investment Bank Berhad 为配售的联合配售代理。
actions.text_en: Appointed CIMB Investment Bank Berhad and Maybank Investment Bank Berhad as joint placement agents for the placement.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 通过收购 Setapak Central Mall，将零售商场资产组合扩大至新增一座三层购物中心。
model_changes.text_en: Expanded the retail mall portfolio with the acquisition of Setapak Central Mall, a three-storey shopping mall.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 终止收购 Klang 工业物业的剩余租赁权益，未新增该工业资产。
model_changes.text_en: Terminated the acquisition of the remaining lease interest in the Klang industrial property, with no addition of that industrial asset.
